goal: Fix #4604: --release-preview (and the other two preview-family flags) must release any preview, preview-recovery or preview-rehearsal lease on the shared preview ref, while holder, generation and exact acquisition sha still bind and a lease on a different ref still refuses. Regression test for a rehearsal lease released via --release-preview.
worker: Same session (author of the #3779 step 8a change that introduced the regression).
prohibited_actions: No workflow, schema, data or setting change.
No weakening of holder, generation or acquisition-sha binding; no release of a lease on a different ref.
No manual lease write; the stranded rehearsal lease from run 39727737391 was released once through the supported CLI with its exact acquisition sha after that run completed.
